tools.name: list_programs
tools.description: Lists the UAE loyalty programs MYLO has a fact guide for: each program's identifier (slug), name, operator, category and the date its facts were last checked against the program's own published pages.

tools.name: get_program_expiry
tools.description: Returns one UAE loyalty program's published rule on when its points expire and, where the program publishes one, what a point is worth, each with the program's own source link and the date it was last checked. Where the program publishes no value per point, the result says so and gives no number.
